title: Mr. Aura's Cobblemon
description: A Cobblemon modpack that adds a bunch of RPG mods and my personal preferences, I guess me being the icon counts as narcissism
body:
This modpack focuses on Cobblemon and various RPG related mods. It can also be played with friends through the friend list backport.

- Cobblemon also has many popular addons such as Mega Showdown, Pokenav, Player XP, Fight or Flight, Cobbledollars, and battle extras. There's also lesser known addons here such as perfect partners, EXP all, and Fierce Competition (because radical trainers is unfair). There's also various texture and resourse packs to improve the looks of the mods.

- The RPG mods improve the players experience with combat by adding new and more powerful items but stronger enemies to face. The ender dragon has been buffed to be much harder than the vanilla version. There's also the artifacts mod, traveler's backpack, inventory pets, and enderite. There's also Iron's spells and spellbooks, the Aether and addons for it, dimensional dungeons, Mowzie's mobs, and enhancted Celestials.

- There's also mods for misc stuff such as the enchantment infuser, pandas falling trees, appleskin, better arceology, yung's structures, Combat roll, Enderite, and muskets.
